newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index jumps 6 pct after budget.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index jumps 6 pct after budget.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index rose 6.17 percent, or 4.68 points, to 80.50 following the announcement of the budget. The Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index was up 4.42 percent at 3,628.53 in early post-budget trade.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market jumped to 17.2 percent from 14.14 on Thursday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
